name: Jeeter Quad Infused Preroll | Berry White
description: Berry White is an indica strain that brings together berry flavors like blueberry and strawberry, with a dash of citrus vibes and a touch of earthiness. The high it gives you is chill yet keeps you alert, making it awesome for a mid-day breather. Imagine putting on some Barry White tunes and sparking up a Berry White Jeeter – it's like a cheat code for good vibes, man!
